title: Kenji's new faces in the game
caption: Kenji now uses the h4 portrait in the office: neutral nk-d80-1, grin g0-h4 (h4 itself) and sheepish s3k-d80-1 from reviews/kenji-expressions-1. The 711 stand-in is gone. Shots hold his first line in the office and swap the face.
